checkpoints.quote: The bug causes the source account to be debited twice when a customer retries a timed-out transfer between two accounts on mobile web.

checkpoints.quote: This issue has affected three customers and is due to the lack of idempotency in retry logic and improper transaction handling.
checkpoints.reason: Both root causes (no idempotency key on retry, and debit/credit not in a single DB transaction) are clearly identified.
